Since you didn't reply within 3 days of our email, the fern should have been **automatically refunded**. Our policy is that no reply within 3 days of the out-of-stock notice means an automatic refund for that item.

Once a refund is issued, it goes back to your **original payment method** and takes:
- **Cards:** 5-10 business days
- **Digital wallets:** 3-5 business days

If you paid by buy-now-pay-later, the refund goes to your instalment provider, which adjusts your remaining payments.

I can't see your order or refund status from here, so I can't confirm the exact date it was issued. If the refund hasn't shown up after the timeframe above, or you'd rather have a similar plant or wait instead, reply with your order number (it looks like LF-123456) and I can escalate this to a Support Lead. I can't promise the original options are still available, since the 3-day window has passed.
